_about: Authored design for every Hoenn map with surf/fishing tables. scripts/emerald_champions_rebuild_wild_water.py consumes this: surf slots 0-1 and Old/Good Rod lead slots come from the anchors, the region pool fills the rest, hunts take the 1% slots. Levels are access-tier levels; wild_encounter.c clamps to the live cap at runtime.

MAP_ROUTE103.why: The first water you see and can't cross. Shore birds and tide-pool life, nothing that outclasses a starter.

MAP_ROUTE102.why: Petalburg pond. Freshwater babies; the first place a Poliwag or Surskit becomes a real option.

MAP_PETALBURG_CITY.why: A harbour town pond fed by the sea: Marill and Lotad meet the first sea fish.

MAP_ROUTE104.why: Briney's beach. Wingull country, Wiglett burrows in the sand, Skrelp hides in the kelp off Petalburg Woods.

MAP_DEWFORD_TOWN.why: Fishing village: the Old Rod's home. Krabby and Shellder under the pier, Corsola on the reef.

MAP_ROUTE106.why: Granite Cave beach. Rock-pool armour: Binacle, Krabby, Clamperl; Dwebble country above the tide line.

MAP_ROUTE105.why: Open crossing south of Dewford. Wishiwashi schools, Mantyke riding Wailmer; the first stretch that feels like ocean.

MAP_ROUTE107.why: Swimmer route. Fast surface fish: Arrokuda, Staryu; Finneon glinting at the surface.

MAP_ROUTE108.why: Abandoned Ship waters. Wreck-dwellers: Frillish, Skrelp, Dhelmise drifting off the hull.

MAP_ROUTE109.why: Slateport beach. Tourist shallows: Shellos, Krabby, Corsola; Wiglett in the sand between the umbrellas.

MAP_SLATEPORT_CITY.why: Working harbour. Tentacool in the slips, Clauncher and Skrelp under the docks, Pyukumuku on the breakwater.

MAP_ROUTE110.why: Cycling Road coast. Electric-tinged shallows: Chinchou, Tynamo-adjacent life, Finneon under the bridge lights.

MAP_ROUTE111.why: Desert oasis pool. Wooper and Barboach mud life; the water is a relief, not a destination.

MAP_ROUTE114.why: Meteor Falls river. Cold fast water: Buizel, Basculin, Corphish; Dratini is the reason people fish here.

MAP_ROUTE115.why: Rustboro's north shore. Rocky shallows: Krabby, Binacle, Shellder; a Mantyke in the surf on a good day.

MAP_ROUTE117.why: Day Care ponds. Gentle water: Lotad, Marill, Ducklett; Tympole singing in the reeds.

MAP_ROUTE118.why: Where the river meets the sea. Carvanha come upstream; the Good Rod is found here and the water proves it.

MAP_ROUTE119.why: Rainforest river. Feebas water; Tympole and Poliwag everywhere, Slowpoke asleep on the bank.

MAP_ROUTE120.why: Marsh route. Wooper mud, Surskit skating the puddles, Chewtle snapping in the reeds.

MAP_ROUTE121.why: Mt. Pyre foreshore. Still, dark water: Frillish drift in from the sea, Ducklett nest here.

MAP_ROUTE123.why: Berry Master's river. Fat, healthy fish: Goldeen, Corphish, Basculin; Buizel racing the current.

MAP_ROUTE122.why: Mt. Pyre's moat. Grey water under the mountain: Frillish, Mareanie, Dhelmise anchors dragged from the shrine.

MAP_LILYCOVE_CITY.why: Big port. Wailmer in the bay, Cramorant on the pilings, Luvdisc for the Contest crowd.

MAP_ROUTE124.why: Dive route. Deep blue with shard hunters below: Mantyke, Clamperl, Finizen playing at the surface.

MAP_ROUTE125.why: Shoal Cave approach. Cold current: Spheal, Seel, Cramorant diving for Arrokuda.

MAP_ROUTE126.why: Sootopolis ring. Clear water over the crater: Alomomola, Wishiwashi, Luvdisc; Tauros-Aqua patrol the reef.

MAP_ROUTE127.why: Open sea east of Mossdeep. Toxic reef: Mareanie, Pyukumuku, Bruxish; Lapras on the horizon.

MAP_ROUTE128.why: Ever Grande approach. Big shapes: Wailmer, Mantyke, Carvanha packs; Finizen follows the boats.

MAP_MOSSDEEP_CITY.why: Island town. Cramorant on every rock, Staryu in the tide pools, Finneon under the Space Center lights.

MAP_EVER_GRANDE_CITY.why: League waterfall. Everything is grown here: the last sea before Victory Road, Lapras as the send-off.

MAP_ROUTE129.why: Deep-sea trench begins. Wailmer pods, Sharpedo lanes; Dondozo is the rumour.

MAP_ROUTE130.why: Mirage Island waters. Nothing is where it should be: Frillish, Wishiwashi, Basculegion surfacing from nowhere.

MAP_ROUTE131.why: Sky Pillar approach. Old sea: Relicanth grounds, Clamperl beds, Gyarados in the swells.

MAP_PACIFIDLOG_TOWN.why: Floating town. People live on the water here: Alomomola nurses, Cramorant fishers, Luvdisc under the rafts.

MAP_ROUTE132.why: Current-swept channel. Fast hunters: Sharpedo, Arrokuda, Bruxish; the Dondozo-Tatsugiri pair rides the current.

MAP_ROUTE133.why: The current strengthens. Spheal carried down from the north, Skrelp tangled in the flow.

MAP_ROUTE134.why: Sealed Chamber trench. The oldest water in Hoenn: Relicanth, Clamperl, Seel; Dondozo guards the way down.

MAP_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY.why: Crater lake. Sacred, sheltered water: Luvdisc, Alomomola, Finizen; Gyarados because the Gym Leader keeps them.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ENTRANCE.why: Under the sea. Pressure life: Clamperl, Relicanth, Chinchou lights; Tatsugiri in the cracks.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM6.why: Inner pools of the cavern. Frillish and Skrelp in the dark, Basculegion where the water goes nowhere.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM7.why: Deepest pool before Kyogre's chamber. Relicanth, Clamperl, Dondozo; the sea's own vault.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_ENTRANCE_ROOM.why: Tidal cave mouth. Spheal and Seel haul out here; Hisuian Qwilfish come in with the tide.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_INNER_ROOM.why: Inner ice pools. Cetoddle territory; Clamperl and Relicanth under the ice shelf, Lapras once a season.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_1R.why: Waterfall cave, front. Buizel and Barboach in the plunge pool; Dratini is why Dragon Tamers train here.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_2R.why: Waterfall cave, upper. Same river, deeper: Basculin, Chinchou; Dratini again for the persistent.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_1R.why: Meteor Falls depths. The Dragon floor: Dratini at every rarity, Goomy-adjacent damp; Dhelmise anchors dragged down the falls.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_2R.why: Rear cave, Sign chamber. Quiet pool; Slowpoke, Wooper, one Feebas for whoever fishes in a shrine.

MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS_3.why: Restored deep woods pond. Lotad, Surskit, Poliwag; a Celebi shrine's water should be gentle.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_CENTER.why: Safari hub lake. Psyduck, Ducklett, Goldeen; the Safari's big fish are elsewhere, this is the calm centre.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_EAST.why: Safari east marsh. Wooper and Tympole mud; Chewtle hunting frogs.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTHWEST.why: Safari cliff pool. Buizel and Basculin in fast water; Dratini for the Acro Bike crowd.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHEAST.why: Safari lowland stream. Marill, Lotad, Goldeen; Dhelmise is the strange thing in the reeds.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHWEST.why: Safari deep pond. Slowpoke banks, Psyduck, Carvanha that shouldn't be this far inland.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_WEST.why: Safari west lake. Ducklett flocks, Surskit, Tympole chorus at dusk.

MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS.why: Buried ruin cistern. Old, still water: Wooper, Barboach; a Dhelmise anchor nobody can explain this far from the sea.

MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_B1F.why: Hot spring cave. Warm water: Slowpoke, Psyduck; Tympole thrive in the heat.

MAP_SEASPRAY_CAVE.why: Restored sea cave off Route 115. Salt pools: Binacle, Clamperl, Shellder; Mantyke sheltering from the surf.

MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_HIDDEN_FLOOR_CORRIDOR.why: Flooded corridors. Frillish and Skrelp in the dark; Dhelmise is the ship's own anchor.

MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_ROOMS_B1F.why: Flooded cabins. Mareanie in the bunks, Clauncher in the pipes; something big drifts past the portholes.

MAP_ALTERING_CAVE_B1F.why: Postgame distortion pool. Fully grown freshwater life and every inland hunt at once; a reward lake.

MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_B2F.why: Victory Road's underground river. Strong swimmers only: Basculin, Buizel, Carvanha; Dratini for the last hunt before the League.
